recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not edit current Medication source for FHIR-7600; future medication dose-form terminology work should start from the FHIR-19296/736542009 history and current terminology tooling evidence.
issue_request: FHIR-7600 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Pharmacy correction asking that Medication.product.form use the appropriate SNOMED CT concept; its final resolution specified SNOMED CT concept is-a 421967003 rather than route-of-administration content.
initial_application: The Jira comment says fixed in svn 6615. The matching git-svn commit c74b8e3ebbf92ccc157a591a1571158559a655cd changed source/medication/valueset-medication-form-codes.xml from SNOMED CT 284009009 to 421967003, matching the accepted FHIR-7600 correction.
additional_context: Medication is active in the current build and old Medication.form maps to Medication.doseForm. Current Medication.doseForm binds to ValueSet/medication-form-codes, whose current Medication source uses SNOMED CT concept is-a 736542009. Later Published/Persuasive FHIR-19296 deliberately changed the medication form parent from 421967003 to 736542009, and a Zulip terminology thread confirms 421967003 was retired as ambiguous while 736542009 was the intended replacement.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source is not bound to the route-of-administration parent corrected by FHIR-7600, and reverting to 421967003 would undo later approved guidance.
